name: Pikachu Jet BC1 (ピカチュウジェット BC1)
description: Skymark's first Pokémon jet (737-800 JA73AB), part of the Pokémon Air Adventures project with Okinawa: Pikachu and other Pokémon over a tropical-sea design on the fuselage, Skymark's navy fin with its star kept.

sources.title: Aviation Wire (2026-04-01): Skymark's entrance ceremony at its Haneda hangar
sources.note: Pikachu Jet BC1, 737-800 JA73AB, at the ceremony on 2026-04-01; Skymark has two Pikachu Jets.

sources.title: Aviation Wire (2026-05-29): Skymark's Pikachu Jet merchandise
sources.note: BC1 (JA73AB) in service from 2021-06-21, BC2 (737-800 JA73NG) from 2022-05-30; BC1's flight-tag key ring sold on board from 2026-06-01.

sources.title: Bulbapedia: Pokémon aircraft
sources.note: BC2 shows Pikachu, Wailord, Magikarp and Shaymin (Sky Forme) in a sea scene; planned to fly about five years.

logos.description: Pikachu and other Pokémon over the fuselage (Pokémon artwork, never drawn from here).

notes: Described in words only: no openly licensed photo of JA73AB in this paint on Commons (searched 2026-11-22). In service from 2021-06-21; at Skymark's hangar on 2026-04-01 and named in May 2026, so current. Draw it when an open photo appears.
